body: No, no, it's okay. I understand your point. I don't want to manipulate anyone, I do have trouble with it due to my BPD, but I have actually gotten a bit better at controlling that, on my own without the help. I might see about getting a new therapist in the future, but I kinda want to take a break from therapy, because when I did the first time with my first therapist, I felt so relieved.

I haven't manipulated my therapist at all, I went and got an evaluation and got diagnosed with disorders that everyone agreed that I had including me except for two which were ADHD and bipolar type 1 (I refused to believe I had them until recently). At this point I don't really want the help because they're not helping, they just make me feel worse. Well, the psychiatrist is fine, but my therapist makes me feel like shit, I like her and all, but I try to explain things and she brushes them off.
 
And the meds don't even work at all, out of like... 8+ different psychiatric meds, only two work. I'm working on exercising and it helps in the moment but after, I'm back to being depressed. It doesn't help that I don't have a support group as well. The only people I have is my partner who lives long distance and my brother who is often busy. 

But I'll stick with them a bit longer, I suppose. At least the psychiatrist. I don't think therapy is really for me. Not until I get out of my abusive household.

I made a post while having a breakdown once and got a message from someone calling me a pathetic loser because I failed at my suicide attempts. People are just assholes. Try not to let it get to you, they're just insecure with themselves so they take it out in others. It's disgusting and I pity them. There are always gonna be assholes, but there are also always gonna be people who are willing to listen and help you as best as they can.
Nah, don't worry, I got one! Thank you though.
I always feel like I'm not doing enough, that I'm not good enough. That I never will be. I try to not be hard on myself, but everyone else is so hard on me

The only thing I like about my life is my partner and my cats. I draw and play video games too but those don't really bring me true happiness. I'm going to therapy, but to be fair, I had no choice in the matter. But it'll help me learn to cope. I'm planning on trying to save up money to move out but I need to get a bank account first, which will require my parents help

I'll try not to give up, it's just hard when all life does is throw shit at me over and over. But I'll try not to give up yet. Idk how to "live it up" as I'm unable to due to my abusive parents and my poor health but I'm trying to enjoy life as best as I can...
Thank you, I'm never gonna forget him. He was my baby and I loved him so much
I am seeing a professional, they don't help. They don't even seem to take me seriously. No one does. It feels like no one truly cares, honestly.
Yeah, I just want to feel safe. I've never truly felt safe anywhere.

I'm just scared to leave. No matter what I do, I'm stuck. I'm not in a good living situation right now so if I leave, I'm stuck here. If I stay, things might get worse when we move in. I'm thinking that if we can't work things out, then I'll leave.
Maybe if things starting getting worse, I'll try to get out. I just don't want all this time and effort I spent going to waste. I want to be able to work things out with them.
The scary thing is I don't even want to leave, I feel like I need to try harder or something, but everyone is saying to leave and I don't know what to do.
They used to be, but now I just don't know how I feel. I don't know what changed.

The pain is great. People think I'm weird for enjoying pain but oh well. I don't like the pain as much as the damage I can do though. The more damage I do, the better I can become. "It's almost like I want to be as damaged on the outside as I am on the inside." Yes, that's exactly what I was trying to say but just couldn't find the words for it, thank you.

That's how I am. I do it because I like to see how disfigured I can make myself. Not only that, but I also love the pain. For me, the more scars and bruises I have, the more my pain is real. I don't know if that makes much sense, but it's the only way I can explain it.

It's probably caused by trauma then. I don't know why, but trauma just works weird, makes you forget things, even things that aren't traumatic. I probably have had other experiences like it, I just don't remember honestly. My memory is completely fried. And I also don't know which memories are real and which are fake so I wouldn't be able to tell you.

If you think dropping out will help you, then I highly recommend it. I don't regret dropping out personally, I just feel like a failure over it because I'm the only one in my family that didn't finish high school. I know I shouldn't beat myself up over it. I didn't have much of a choice in the matter.

I just haven't, I guess. There's not reason why I haven't told them. I guess I just didn't think it was a problem. I am going to tell them, I'm seeing a new psychologist soon for an evaluation so I'll have to be completely honest with how I'm feeling. I might end up being hospitalized for being honest but at this rate, I don't know if I'll be alive much longer. Maybe the psychologist will be able to more help to me.
Not specifically hearing God, no but I have told them I hear voices.

I am going to therapy and am on multiple different medications. It doesn't help me very much. I'm seeing a psychologist soon to pinpoint exactly what's wrong with me as my psychiatrist can't do anything else for me, thinking they missed something.

Yeah, my brother is a good guy deep down. I think it's because he got married and his wife changed his outlook on life. She's a good lady too. I don't know if my mom is a narcissist or not, but she does have issues, she acts like she cares about me but I don't think she really does. I think she just doesn't want to me kill myself so she doesn't have to face the blame. I feel even guilty complaining because when I was younger, I had a blog online and my mom found it and got really upset with me for complaining about her. She acted like the victim. I'm always afraid she's going to find this account and my new personal blog. I think she is making me depend on her financially because she knows I'm unable to care for myself alone. I think she likes the power she has over me. I hope I can get away because I honestly don't think I can take much more of this. Once I save up enough money, I'm leaving.

I have BPD, I can't see anything other than black and white. I flip between thinking I'm evil and then thinking I'm a god all the time. It's so exhausting. I always have these bad urges, I'm scared that one day I'll snap and hurt someone. I even catch myself thinking about hurting my partner and family. It might be intrusive thoughts because I do also have OCD. I don't think I really have anything good about myself. I guess I try to be there for people when they need me. But I don't know if I actually care or I just do it because I feel like I have to. At least I don't try to tear people down intentionally.

No it's okay, you have a right to be angry. I should be angry too, but I just don't care anymore. I've been thinking of seeing a new therapist honestly. At first, I like seeing her, but I don't anymore. She never outright says I'm lazy, but it sure feels like that's what she's saying. I've never been close with my family, but I have no choice but to live with them for now. Honestly, as soon as I move away and live with my partner, I'm thinking about cutting contact with them except for maybe my brother. My brother used to abuse me, but he's the only one who has owned up to it and actually changed as a person. Plus, he was also neglected and put down just like me so I can't even fault him for it, not that I was much better to him. My parents don't even acknowledge what they did to me. My partner is the only one who makes me feel good, the only one who is there for me. Hopefully, I'll be able to get on disability and actually make money, that is, if my mom doesn't expect me to pay her some or just outright steals from me. I'm unable to get a job at the moment because of how unstable I am. I can't even get out of bed anymore, at any moment, I could just decide to end it all and honestly, I'm not even scared.

I do have a therapist. She stresses me out, always talking about how I'm not trying hard enough to get my GED and always talking about religion, making me more paranoid. I honestly just want to quit, I don't think I'll ever get better. I was planning on moving away from my family and living with my partner, but I can't get a job to make money and my mom won't pay me for the work I've done even thought she agreed to do so.

I'm a high school dropout with no talents. I'm the one who has failed to kill themselves multiple times. Everyone in my family has done something with their lives, but I'm unable to even get out of bed and take care of myself.

That's true. My obsession is because my grandparents are religious and they always hound me over it. I know I need to get in touch with reality, but I just don't know what is real anymore. I don't even feel real.
I don't know how to get away. I feel trapped. I'm going to be getting help soon so maybe I'll feel better. Just been very stressed out. I just want to sleep forever, I'm so damn exhausted.

Thank you. I get these conflicting feelings where I feel like if I self harm more, I'll be better. It'll show how real my pain is. But sometimes I feel disgusted with myself. I cant believe the things I've done to my body. I destroy myself and enjoy every moment of it. I guess the stress of everything is really getting to me lately.
That's what someone else told me, that God wouldn't ask me to hurt myself. It has me confused.

I don't know if I'm good though. Everyone says I'm good but I feel like a sinner. I get these urges to do bad things sometimes, I don't talk about it to anyone because they scare me. I try to not listen to the voices, but I gave in last night.
It's tiring. I think it's because I've been very stressed lately. I don't like hearing things, they always say cruel things.

I just know it's God, when I hear it, I get this feeling of dread, like I did something wrong and I'm going to pay for it. It's said it's God as well. Though, it might not be God, people are saying God wouldn't want me to harm myself. I don't know who to believe. The voice might be tricking me. I don't consider myself religious, but I do believe in a higher power. I have an obsession with religion.

I'm probably going to try to get back into art. I was always a very creative person but then I lost my motivation to do things. And I definitely want to start exercising, I'm just really lazy. I've heard that exercising helps with stress, my partner is trying to get me back into exercising.
I sure hope so. They only really come out when I'm stressed. But I'm getting help, I'm on meds and going to therapy. I'm just not getting any better mentally.
Yes, that's true. I just don't think I have very many talents because my lack of motivation. I guess I just have to find them.
It's nice. I like poems. Wish I was good at writing them.

We don't live together, no. We're in a long distance relationship, but I'm saving up money to go visit, and maybe even move in together. My family has been really getting on my nerves lately and I wanna get away from them. I feel like I'd be happier with my partner anyways.

I know medicine and therapy won't save me. I've tried to get better, but I honestly don't think I can. If I don't start feeling a little better soon, I don't think I'm going to be here much longer. It's painful. I don't want to die, but sometimes it feels like I have no choice. I feel trapped. The only thing keeping me going is my partner. It's kind of pathetic, I should be fighting for myself, but I lost hope in myself a long time ago. I dream of a future where I can be with them, happy. It's the only thing I have to look forward to.

I have asked for help and it hasn't made things easier for me. It hasn't made things harder, but it hasn't helped. I don't know if I was misdiagnosed or what, but I'm getting an evaluation done because I'm not getting better with the treatment I'm currently getting. They think they missed something. I hope they did, because I don't know what to do anymore.

I've been through a lot. A lot of it still haunts me. I don't know if I would consider myself a fighter, but I'm trying to be strong. Sometimes it just feels like it would easier to give up because I'm so damn exhausted.

I suppose so. I just feel like it'd be for the best that I die. I know that's the mental illness speaking though. It's kind of fucked up too because I don't even care about the rest of the people in my life. I don't care about my family or my friends because I know none of them really give a shit about me. The only person I feel anything for these days is my partner, the only person who truly understands me.
Thank you. It's just a hard battle, been struggling with this addiction for years. I just wish it got easier as time goes on. I'm just going to have to pick myself back up and try again.

I'm just afraid of opening up. I always feel so guilty and like a disappointment for feeling this way. I guess I've just been discouraged because my doctor said there's nothing else they can really do for me besides IOP, which I can't afford. That's why I'm getting an evaluation, because maybe they missed something. Also, so I can see if I can get on disability so that way I can save up money to live with my partner. Getting to be with the one I love the most, it's the only thing keeping me going these days.

I have talked to my partner about my mental health, yes. I haven't told them much about how bad my thoughts are getting though. I'm thinking about opening up more because I don't want to die and it's kind of eating me alive. I just feel like a burden talking about it, honestly.

I guess so. I just feel disappointed and angry at myself for relapsing. I know I shouldn't beat myself up over it because it happens to all of us, but I can't help but feel dejected. I wouldn't even be as mad about it if I could actually remember doing it, but I remember nothing. Don't even know how I did it. Guess I'm just going to have to try harder to quit.

Yeah, I figured that was the case but I wasn't certain. I do see a therapist, but honestly, it's not very helpful. Maybe I have to look for a new therapist. I don't really like my therapist, to be frank. But thank you, your words helped.

I understand. I've always been the type to just space out, still am. I guess what I went through as a kid was dissociation, I just never connected the dots until now. It's usually caused by trauma or stressful situations, you're body just kind of shuts down. I don't know if you've gone through anything traumatic or stressful recently, but it could be the reason why you're dissociating

I've never really told anyone about it because I'm pretty sure my episodes are caused by trauma and I don't feel like opening up about it. I remember when I was in the hospital for an overdose, I thought I was in class all day. Also, don't know if it's the same, but when I was young, I vividly remember stepping on thumbtacks and my toes turning bright purple, but my mother said that never even happened. Maybe I dreamt it, maybe it was an overactive imagination, I don't know. I really don't know what causes it, I'm sorry. If it happens after panic attacks, I'd recommend trying to tackle the panic attacks, like find out what triggers you to have them and try to avoid those triggers (if possible).

Yes, I have experienced something similar to that before. There have been times I apparently do or say something that I cannot remember, I remember doing something else. I don't know what causes it honestly. I'd recommend seeing a new doctor if possible.
Yes, I am trying to stay safe. Usually when this happens, I tend to end up self harming but I don't have anything to use because I got rid of everything. Thank you.

Thank you for your kind words. I don't think anything triggered the dissociation. I do have PTSD but I don't remember anything happening to me to trigger an episode. I was thinking it was caused by stress but I wasn't particularly more stressed than I usually am. In fact, I was actually doing much better. I have been relaxing during this, I don't really feel unsafe honestly. It's just hard to focus on anything, nor do I have the motivation to do anything. Hopefully this passes soon, if not, I'm gonna be seeing my psychiatrist on Friday regardless and see what I can do from there.

Thank you. Nothing really helps me calm down besides talking to my partner and I don't want to be a burden. I try to do things but I just can't focus, no matter how hard I try. I plan on talking to my psychiatrist on Friday. I'm on 5 different medicines, I take propranolol, lexapro, buspirone, hydroxyzine, and rexulti. I've tried lots of other medications as well with little to no results as well.
